at-0001.content: Round all monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Money-moving operations need idempotency_key
at-0006.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: if `ledgerly.audit.events()` already has an entry with that key, return the original result without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry written via `audit.record`.
